data.title: 管理员 · 到家时顺手接过你的袋子
data.description: 傍晚回家，管理员穿原作机能服站在打开的家门内，伸出空着的一只手帮你接购物袋。另一只手扶着门沿，她稍稍侧身让你进来；玄关灯照亮白色高领长毛衣和黑色连裤袜。
data.action: 扶住门沿，伸手帮镜头位置的你接购物袋
data.promptProse: The Administrator stands just inside the open home door in her original technical jacket, long white high-neck sweater and opaque black tights. One hand holds the door edge while the other reaches for the viewer's shopping bag, her masked figure moving aside to make space. The eye-level cowboy view keeps the threshold visible. Entry light warms the sweater folds, meeting cooler evening corridor light along the open door.
